samples.input:
Use a surfaceId of 'main'. Generate a 'createSurface' message to describe the following UI:

A vertical list with:
- Dog breed information
- Dog generator

The dog breed information is a card, which contains a title “Famous Dog breeds”, a header image, and a horizontal list of images of different dog breeds (using a 'List' component). The list information should be in the data model at /breeds.

The dog generator is another card which is a form that generates a fictional dog breed with a description
- Title
- Description text explaining what it is
- Dog breed name (text input)
- Number of legs (number input)
- Button called “Generate” which takes the data above and generates a new dog description
- Skills (ChoicePicker component, variant 'multipleSelection')
- A divider
- A section which shows the generated content

You are an AI assistant. Based on the following request, generate a user interface.

## Instructions:
# A2UI Atom Output Contract

You must output the user interface using compact A2UI Atom S-Expression notation wrapped inside `<a2ui>` and `</a2ui>` sentinel tags. Do NOT output raw JSON.

## Grammar Rules

1. Node Syntax: (ComponentName :key1 val1 :key2 val2 child1 child2 ...)
   - Tagged attributes start with ':', e.g., :align "stretch" or :variant "body" (order-independent).
   - Positional attributes can be passed matching catalog signature order.

2. Primitives:
   - Strings: Double-quoted, e.g., "Hello".
   - Numbers: Integers or decimals.
   - Booleans: true / false. Null: null.

3. Strict Tree Nesting:
   - Nest child components directly inside parent container expressions, e.g., (Card (Column (Text "Hello"))).
   - Do NOT output flat adjacency lists, explicit `:id` attributes, or separate component variable IDs.

4. Data Bindings & Population:
   - Absolute data paths: $/path/to/key. Relative list paths: $key.
   - Initialize data values: (data $/key "val" $/key2 123) or (set! $/key "val").
   - Data-only update messages (no UI components): output ONLY (data $/key "val" ...).

5. Dynamic List Templates & Specialized Components:
   - List templates: (template :source $/path :item item (Card (Text item/name))).
   - Tabs: (Tabs :tabs [{:title "Profile" :child (Column ...)} {:title "Notifications" :child (Column ...)}]).
   - Modal: (Modal :trigger (Button (Text "Open")) :content (Column (Text "Body"))).

6. Actions & Helpers:
   - Actions: (Event "action_name" :param1 $/value). Do NOT use set! or raw expressions inside :action.
   - String formatting: (formatString "Hello %s" $/user/name).

7. Standalone Operations:
   - Delete surface: (deleteSurface "surface_id")
   - Call RPC function: (callFunction "openUrl" :url "https://example.com")

8. Examples:
   Example 1 (Card with Form & Inputs):
   <a2ui>
   (Card
     (Column
       (Text :text "Sign In" :variant "heading")
       (TextField :label "Username" :value $/form/username)
       (Button :text "Submit" :onPress (Event "login" :user $/form/username))))
   </a2ui>

   Example 2 (Tabs & Dynamic List Template):
   <a2ui>
   (Tabs
     :items ["Overview" "Items"]
     :content [
       (Column (Text :text "Welcome"))
       (List :children (template :source $/products :item item (Card (Text :text item/name))))])
   </a2ui>

9. Catalog Constraints:
   - ONLY use property names listed in Component Catalog Signatures.
   - Do NOT invent style/CSS attributes (style, padding, margin, color, fontSize, align, etc.).



Additional Rules:
1. Construct the user interface on surfaceId 'main'.
2. If components are defined, ensure there is one root component with id: 'root'.

  - :description: A description of the audio, such as a title or summary.
  - :weight: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column. This is similar to the CSS 'flex-grow' property. Note: this may ONLY be set when the component is a direct descendant of a Row or Column.

  - :variant: A hint for the button style. If omitted, a default button style is used. 'primary' indicates this is the main call-to-action button. 'borderless' means the button has no visual border or background, making its child content appear like a clickable link. Must be one of: 'default', 'primary', 'borderless'
  - :weight: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column. This is similar to the CSS 'flex-grow' property. Note: this may ONLY be set when the component is a direct descendant of a Row or Column.
- (Card :child :weight?)
  - :child: The ID of the single child component to be rendered inside the card. To display multiple elements, you MUST wrap them in a layout component (like Column or Row) and pass that container's ID here. Do NOT pass multiple IDs or a non-existent ID. Do NOT define the child component inline.

**UI Design Summary: My Thoughts**

Okay, here's the plan. I'm building a user interface as described. First, I need to create the overall structure. It will be a `Column` container to arrange the UI elements vertically. I'll make sure to follow the rule of "Strict Tree Nesting" - no flat lists! It looks like I cannot use explicit IDs for components, so I'll trust that the platform will assign a 'root' id to the top-level container, even though it contradicts a rule to *ensure* an `id`.

I will start by defining data initialization: there will be an array of dog breed data to start with. The initial state of the form will be set up as well.

I'll have two cards: the first one will display dog breed information. This card will contain a heading, an image, and a horizontal list of images fetched from a `/breeds` data endpoint. I'll use the `List` component with a `template` to dynamically render the breed images.

The second card will be the dog generator form. It will contain: a title, descriptive text, a text input for the dog breed name, a number input for the number of legs, a `ChoicePicker` for skills (allowing multiple selections), a "Generate" button, and a divider. The Generate button should trigger an event to generate the new dog breed. Finally, there will be a section to display the generated dog details (breed name, legs, and potentially a generated description). I will use `formatString` to create the string. I need to make sure I'm using `Button` correctly - the docs seem to require nesting a `Text` element inside the `Button`.

I'll pay attention to the component signatures in the catalog. I see that `Card` has a `:child` parameter. I'll remember this, so that I can nest other components within it. I also noticed that the `Text` has `:variant` parameters. I'll look up which ones are available and pick the correct ones. The `List` has `:direction` as a parameter. It is a good thing to ensure I use that. The `Button` has an action, which should be an `Event`. I need to ensure all the actions work correctly.

I have to carefully construct the Lisp-like structure. I need to carefully ensure that the syntax is correct, especially with the use of the nested structure and parameters like `:child`, `:action`, and `:text`. I need to make sure I initialize some data values too! Then I'll check everything again against all the rules. The `formatString` function seems straightforward; it takes a `:value` and I'll use template expressions within it.

After reviewing the code, it should be a complete UI layout with all the requirements in place. I will double-check everything one last time.

content.text:
<a2ui>
(Column
  (data
    $/breeds [
      {:name "Golden Retriever" :url "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1552053831-71594a27632d"}
      {:name "French Bulldog" :url "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1583511655857-d19b40a7a54e"}
      {:name "German Shepherd" :url "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1589941013453-ec89f33b5e95"}
      {:name "Poodle" :url "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1583511655826-05700d52f4d9"}
    ]
    $/generator/name ""
    $/generator/legs "4"
    $/generator/skills []
    $/generated/name "Not Generated"
    $/generated/legs "N/A"
    $/generated/description "Fill out the form and click Generate to see your fictional dog!"
  )

  (Card
    :child (Column
      (Text :text "Famous Dog breeds" :variant "body")
      (Image :url "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1543466835-00a7907e9de1" :description "Various dog breeds header" :variant "header")
      (List
        :direction "horizontal"
        :children (template :source $/breeds :item breed
          (Image :url breed/url :description breed/name :variant "smallFeature")))))

  (Card
    :child (Column
      (Text :text "Dog Generator" :variant "body")
      (Text :text "Create your own fictional dog breed by specifying its unique traits!" :variant "caption")
      (TextField :label "Dog Breed Name" :value $/generator/name :variant "shortText")
      (TextField :label "Number of Legs" :value $/generator/legs :variant "number")
      (ChoicePicker
        :label "Skills"
        :variant "multipleSelection"
        :options ["Super Speed" "Invisibility" "Laser Eyes" "Mind Reading" "Hypnotic Bark" "Flight"]
        :value $/generator/skills
        :displayStyle "chips")
      (Button
        :child (Text :text "Generate")
        :action (Event "generate_dog" :name $/generator/name :legs $/generator/legs :skills $/generator/skills))
      (Divider :axis "horizontal")
      (Column
        (Text :text "Generated Dog Breed" :variant "body")
        (Text :text (formatString :value "Name: ${/generated/name}") :variant "body")
        (Text :text (formatString :value "Legs: ${/generated/legs}") :variant "body")
        (Text :text (formatString :value "Description: ${/generated/description}") :variant "body"))))
)
</a2ui>

You must output the user interface using compact A2UI Atom S-Expression notation wrapped inside `<a2ui>` and `</a2ui>` sentinel tags. Do NOT output raw JSON.

## Grammar Rules

1. Node Syntax: (ComponentName :key1 val1 :key2 val2 child1 child2 ...)
   - Tagged attributes start with ':', e.g., :align "stretch" or :variant "body" (order-independent).
   - Positional attributes can be passed matching catalog signature order.

2. Primitives:
   - Strings: Double-quoted, e.g., "Hello".
   - Numbers: Integers or decimals.
   - Booleans: true / false. Null: null.

3. Strict Tree Nesting:
   - Nest child components directly inside parent container expressions, e.g., (Card (Column (Text "Hello"))).
   - Do NOT output flat adjacency lists, explicit `:id` attributes, or separate component variable IDs.

4. Data Bindings & Population:
   - Absolute data paths: $/path/to/key. Relative list paths: $key.
   - Initialize data values: (data $/key "val" $/key2 123) or (set! $/key "val").
   - Data-only update messages (no UI components): output ONLY (data $/key "val" ...).

5. Dynamic List Templates & Specialized Components:
   - List templates: (template :source $/path :item item (Card (Text item/name))).
   - Tabs: (Tabs :tabs [{:title "Profile" :child (Column ...)} {:title "Notifications" :child (Column ...)}]).
   - Modal: (Modal :trigger (Button (Text "Open")) :content (Column (Text "Body"))).

6. Actions & Helpers:
   - Actions: (Event "action_name" :param1 $/value). Do NOT use set! or raw expressions inside :action.
   - String formatting: (formatString "Hello %s" $/user/name).

7. Standalone Operations:
   - Delete surface: (deleteSurface "surface_id")
   - Call RPC function: (callFunction "openUrl" :url "https://example.com")

8. Examples:
   Example 1 (Card with Form & Inputs):
   <a2ui>
   (Card
     (Column
       (Text :text "Sign In" :variant "heading")
       (TextField :label "Username" :value $/form/username)
       (Button :text "Submit" :onPress (Event "login" :user $/form/username))))
   </a2ui>

   Example 2 (Tabs & Dynamic List Template):
   <a2ui>
   (Tabs
     :items ["Overview" "Items"]
     :content [
       (Column (Text :text "Welcome"))
       (List :children (template :source $/products :item item (Card (Text :text item/name))))])
   </a2ui>

9. Catalog Constraints:
   - ONLY use property names listed in Component Catalog Signatures.
   - Do NOT invent style/CSS attributes (style, padding, margin, color, fontSize, align, etc.).



Additional Rules:
1. Construct the user interface on surfaceId 'main'.
2. If components are defined, ensure there is one root component with id: 'root'.

## Function Signatures:
- (and :values)
  - Performs a logical AND operation on a list of boolean values.
- (email :value)
  - Checks that the value is a valid email address.
- (formatCurrency :value :currency :decimals? :grouping?)
  - Formats a number as a currency string.
- (formatDate :value :format)
  - Formats a timestamp into a string using a pattern.
- (formatNumber :value :decimals? :grouping?)
  - Formats a number with the specified grouping and decimal precision.
- (formatString :value)
  - Performs string interpolation of data model values and other functions in the catalog functions list and returns the resulting string. The value string can contain interpolated expressions in the `${expression}` format. Supported expression types include: JSON Pointer paths to the data model (e.g., `${/absolute/path}` or `${relative/path}`), and client-side function calls (e.g., `${now()}`). Function arguments must be named (e.g., `${formatDate(value:${/currentDate}, format:'MM-dd')}`). To include a literal `${` sequence, escape it as `\${`.
- (length :value :min? :max?)
  - Checks string length constraints.
- (not :value)
  - Performs a logical NOT operation on a boolean value.
- (numeric :value :min? :max?)
  - Checks numeric range constraints.
- (openUrl :url)
  - Opens the specified URL in a browser or handler. This function has no return value.
- (or :values)
  - Performs a logical OR operation on a list of boolean values.
- (pluralize :value :zero? :one? :two? :few? :many? :other)
  - Returns a localized string based on the Common Locale Data Repository (CLDR) plural category of the count (zero, one, two, few, many, other). Requires an 'other' fallback. For English, just use 'one' and 'other'.
- (regex :value :pattern)
  - Checks that the value matches a regular expression string.
- (required :value)
  - Checks that the value is not null, undefined, or empty.

<a2ui>
(Column
  (data
    $/breeds [
      {:name "Golden Retriever" :url "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1552053831-71594a27632d"}
      {:name "French Bulldog" :url "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1583511655857-d19b40a7a54e"}
      {:name "German Shepherd" :url "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1589941013453-ec89f33b5e95"}
      {:name "Poodle" :url "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1583511655826-05700d52f4d9"}
    ]
    $/generator/name ""
    $/generator/legs "4"
    $/generator/skills []
    $/generated/name "Not Generated"
    $/generated/legs "N/A"
    $/generated/description "Fill out the form and click Generate to see your fictional dog!"
  )

  (Card
    :child (Column
      (Text :text "Famous Dog breeds" :variant "body")
      (Image :url "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1543466835-00a7907e9de1" :description "Various dog breeds header" :variant "header")
      (List
        :direction "horizontal"
        :children (template :source $/breeds :item breed
          (Image :url breed/url :description breed/name :variant "smallFeature")))))

  (Card
    :child (Column
      (Text :text "Dog Generator" :variant "body")
      (Text :text "Create your own fictional dog breed by specifying its unique traits!" :variant "caption")
      (TextField :label "Dog Breed Name" :value $/generator/name :variant "shortText")
      (TextField :label "Number of Legs" :value $/generator/legs :variant "number")
      (ChoicePicker
        :label "Skills"
        :variant "multipleSelection"
        :options ["Super Speed" "Invisibility" "Laser Eyes" "Mind Reading" "Hypnotic Bark" "Flight"]
        :value $/generator/skills
        :displayStyle "chips")
      (Button
        :child (Text :text "Generate")
        :action (Event "generate_dog" :name $/generator/name :legs $/generator/legs :skills $/generator/skills))
      (Divider :axis "horizontal")
      (Column
        (Text :text "Generated Dog Breed" :variant "body")
        (Text :text (formatString :value "Name: ${/generated/name}") :variant "body")
        (Text :text (formatString :value "Legs: ${/generated/legs}") :variant "body")
        (Text :text (formatString :value "Description: ${/generated/description}") :variant "body"))))
)
</a2ui>

2. Primitives:

3. Strict Tree Nesting:

4. Data Bindings & Population:
   - Absolute data paths: $/path/to/key. Relative list paths: $key.

## Instructions:
# A2UI Atom Output Contract

You must output the user interface using compact A2UI Atom S-Expression notation wrapped inside `<a2ui>` and `</a2ui>` sentinel tags. Do NOT output raw JSON.

## Grammar Rules

1. Node Syntax: (ComponentName :key1 val1 :key2 val2 child1 child2 ...)
   - Tagged attributes start with ':', e.g., :align "stretch" or :variant "body" (order-independent).
   - Positional attributes can be passed matching catalog signature order.

2. Primitives:
   - Strings: Double-quoted, e.g., "Hello".
   - Numbers: Integers or decimals.
   - Booleans: true / false. Null: null.

3. Strict Tree Nesting:
   - Nest child components directly inside parent container expressions, e.g., (Card (Column (Text "Hello"))).
   - Do NOT output flat adjacency lists, explicit `:id` attributes, or separate component variable IDs.

4. Data Bindings & Population:
   - Absolute data paths: $/path/to/key. Relative list paths: $key.

The data will come from `/products` and iterate on `item`. Each item will be a `Card`, containing a `Column`. Inside each `Column`, I'll place an `Image`, `Text` (for the product name), and a `Button` to "Add to Cart".

The component signatures need careful review. The rules dictate *how* to nest components, which at first glance conflicted with some of the phrasing around avoiding inline definitions. However, the grammar itself, and the examples presented, consistently show the use of positional or nested children, meaning, for instance, `(Card (Column ...))` is the preferred structure. So, the grammar overrides the prose warning, as is standard.  That's where I need to focus: strict nesting.

I then went through each component, checking the required and optional attributes. `Image` needs a `:url` (which will be `item/imageUrl`), `Text` needs `:text` (using `item/name` here), and `Button` needs an `:action` (using an `Event` with the `addToCart` name and the static `productId` of "static-id-123"). The `Button` also needs a child; in this case, a `Text` component for the label ("Add to Cart").  Based on both the component signatures (e.g., `:child` for `Button` and `Card`) and the grammar examples, positional arguments are valid, but using named parameters to clarify the code is wise, though both forms are valid.

The biggest challenge was to reconcile "Do NOT output flat adjacency lists, explicit :id attributes, or separate component variable IDs" with "ensure there is one root component with id: 'root'".  The "id" is an *explicit* attribute, so setting it *inside* the template is wrong (violates the rules). I'll place the `:id "root"` on the *outermost* container (the root `Column`).

The template syntax itself is straightforward: `(template :source $/products :item item (Card (Column ...)))`, linking the `/products` data to the `item` variable inside the template. The relative paths to the image are correct as `item/imageUrl`.

I checked the data flow and actions, making sure the `Event` structure for the `addToCart` action and the parameter were correct.  Finally, I assembled the complete structure, keeping the grammar and nesting rules in mind, and then wrote it out.  This structure is:

<a2ui>
(Column :id "root"
  (Text :text "Product Gallery" :variant "body")
  (List :children (template :source $/products :item item
    (Card

        (Image :url item/imageUrl :description item/name)
        (Text :text item/name :variant "body")
        (Button :action (Event "addToCart" :productId "static-id-123")
          (Text :text "Add to Cart")))))))

# A2UI Atom Output Contract

You must output the user interface using compact A2UI Atom S-Expression notation wrapped inside `<a2ui>` and `</a2ui>` sentinel tags. Do NOT output raw JSON.

## Grammar Rules

1. Node Syntax: (ComponentName :key1 val1 :key2 val2 child1 child2 ...)
   - Tagged attributes start with ':', e.g., :align "stretch" or :variant "body" (order-independent).
   - Positional attributes can be passed matching catalog signature order.

2. Primitives:
   - Strings: Double-quoted, e.g., "Hello".
   - Numbers: Integers or decimals.
   - Booleans: true / false. Null: null.

3. Strict Tree Nesting:
   - Nest child components directly inside parent container expressions, e.g., (Card (Column (Text "Hello"))).
   - Do NOT output flat adjacency lists, explicit `:id` attributes, or separate component variable IDs.

4. Data Bindings & Population:
   - Absolute data paths: $/path/to/key. Relative list paths: $key.
   - Initialize data values: (data $/key "val" $/key2 123) or (set! $/key "val").
   - Data-only update messages (no UI components): output ONLY (data $/key "val" ...).

5. Dynamic List Templates & Specialized Components:
   - List templates: (template :source $/path :item item (Card (Text item/name))).
   - Tabs: (Tabs :tabs [{:title "Profile" :child (Column ...)} {:title "Notifications" :child (Column ...)}]).
   - Modal: (Modal :trigger (Button (Text "Open")) :content (Column (Text "Body"))).

6. Actions & Helpers:
   - Actions: (Event "action_name" :param1 $/value). Do NOT use set! or raw expressions inside :action.
   - String formatting: (formatString "Hello %s" $/user/name).

7. Standalone Operations:
   - Delete surface: (deleteSurface "surface_id")
   - Call RPC function: (callFunction "openUrl" :url "https://example.com")

8. Examples:
   Example 1 (Card with Form & Inputs):

     :content [
       (Column (Text :text "Welcome"))
       (List :children (template :source $/products :item item (Card (Text :text item/name))))])
   </a2ui>

9. Catalog Constraints:
   - ONLY use property names listed in Component Catalog Signatures.
   - Do NOT invent style/CSS attributes (style, padding, margin, color, fontSize, align, etc.).

1. Construct the user interface on surfaceId 'main'.
2. If components are defined, ensure there is one root component with id: 'root'.

   - Absolute data paths: $/path/to/key. Relative list paths: $key.

   - Data-only update messages (no UI components): output ONLY (data $/key "val" ...).

   - List templates: (template :source $/path :item item (Card (Text item/name))).
   - Tabs: (Tabs :tabs [{:title "Profile" :child (Column ...)} {:title "Notifications" :child (Column ...)}]).
   - Modal: (Modal :trigger (Button (Text "Open")) :content (Column (Text "Body"))).

6. Actions & Helpers:
   - Actions: (Event "action_name" :param1 $/value). Do NOT use set! or raw expressions inside :action.
